limitations: Only the standard 80% hourly-correlation pathway and article 9.3 rates are modelled; no additionality, sanctions, access suspension or total compliance cost.
Positive demand in every hour of one complete Europe/Madrid calendar month; zero-load treatment and other billing zones are unsupported.
All profiles, eligibility and prices are synthetic assumptions, not customer quotes or measured operation.
Top-up is an all-in incremental shaping premium; common energy costs cancel by assumption. No physical dispatch, storage attribution, market settlement or revenue is calculated.
Monthly compensation is provisional under article 9.4 and subject to annual official regularisation; this is not an invoice.
evidence_gaps: Obtain metering and allocated eligible backing, producer/contract evidence, and applicability review.
Confirm additionality, exceptions, storage accounting, tariff version and official billing interpretation.
Obtain executable shaping quotes including settlement effects, taxes and implementation costs.
